mapping.heading: Automatic grid

high.label: Good match
high.description: We placed every ingredient in the steps that use it. Please give the preview a quick look.

medium.description: We could place most ingredients, but some steps are unclear. Preview the grid before you choose it.

low.label: Could not map reliably
low.description: We could not tell which ingredients go with which steps. The recipe will be saved as a list unless you try the grid yourself.

mapping.fixHint: To correct the grid, change the ingredient row numbers in a step below. The preview updates as you type. Avoid reordering ingredient lines; change the numbers instead.

preview.heading: Grid preview
preview.skip: Skip the preview and go to the recipe fields
preview.summary: {steps, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} over {rows, plural, one {# ingredient row} other {# ingredient rows}} in {sections, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}.
preview.noColumns: No step in this part is linked to ingredients yet.
preview.invalidIntro: The grid cannot be shown yet. Fix these before saving as a grid, or use the list view:

explain.body: Cellar reads the steps and guesses which ingredients each one uses. The grid then shows each step next to those ingredients. This is a guess made by fixed rules on this server; nothing is sent to an AI service. Recipes the guess cannot handle are best kept as a list. A drag-and-drop grid editor is planned; until then, change the row numbers in each step.
